Main file: the Chapter 3 per-unit utility tables (per t feed unless stated): crude and vacuum distillation (Table 3.77), FCC and RCC (3.33) with regenerator CO2 (3.35), catalytic reforming (3.42, first column only), delayed coking (3.44), flexicoking (3.45), naphtha/distillate/residue hydrotreating (3.63), hydrocracking and residue hydroconversion (3.66), SMR (3.67), isomerisation (3.71), etherification (3.61), gas plant (3.12), visbreaking (3.84), alkylation (3.19), SRU (4.85); single-plant examples with fuel derived from GWh/yr and throughput (TOTAL Mitteldeutschland CDU/VDU Table 3.78 and visbreaker 3.85; OMV Schwechat hydrotreaters 3.65); EU refinery sample (Table 3.2: 2.75 GJ/t, 0.22 t CO2/t); progressive distillation (Sect. 4.19.1, Table 4.68, per-t values derived from MWh/h and TOE/100 t); capex: FCC feed hydrotreaters (Tables 4.10-4.11, questionnaire 36), new SRU+TGTU (Table 4.91), HF and H2SO4 alkylation (4.3, 4.5), thermal gas oil unit, oil-gasification IGCC (Sect. 4.14.3, Table 4.44); heater/boiler efficiencies (Sect. 4.10.3.1). Steam produced and hydrogen consumed are in _flows. _measures: progressive distillation, ceramic coatings, air preheat, Table 4.36 heat-exchange add-ons, steam traps, FCC expander, soaker visbreaker, DWC, multi-effect deasphalting, RCPSA. Not loaded: BAT-AELs and all non-GHG pollutant, water, waste, noise and storage data; base oil units (lube-specific); polymerisation (power printed as kW/t); calciner; the BAT conclusions. Traps: (1) Table 3.42 reforming columns are misaligned in the text layer (semi-regen fuel 71.5 t/kt, CCR electricity 6 142 kWh without time base) - only the all-types range column was taken; (2) Sect. 4.14.1 prints SMR net energy as 12.5-14.2 kJ/Nm3 - must be MJ/Nm3; (3) progressive distillation and hydrovisbreaker capex printed as EUR 41 000-55 000 and 85 000/115 000 per t/yr - implausible, kept in _other-values only; (4) Table 3.59 RFG factor 43 kg CO2/GJ is low against NG 56 - as printed; (5) Tables 3.78/3.85 single-plant loads for non-CO2 pollutants are computed from limit values; (6) most cost figures carry no price year (2015 used and flagged) and some 1995-1999 costs are printed in EUR; (7) heating-value basis never stated for unit fuel; (8) the SRU utility table does not name its denominator (t sulphur assumed); (9) Table 3.2 energy is net thermal energy per t of all feedstock, not per t crude.
